scope: Read-only scoring-method and arithmetic review on the frozen observed request cohort. No forecasts, source updates, or canonical score changes.

protocol.selected_primary_definition: For each planned request, arithmetic mean of its raw daily-lead CRPS values in return units (no training-SD or sqrt-lead divisor). Freeze within-bucket weights from the planned schedule: equal asset/portfolio branch weight where both exist, then equal class, family, and series weights, then equal planned requests within series. Give short, medium, and long calendar-horizon buckets 1/3 each. No quarter level.
protocol.headline: 100 * (1 - Q_candidate / Q_fixed_WR), where Q is the equal-third mean of the three bucket mean losses.
protocol.bucket_definition: Short: requested end through 3 calendar years; medium: more than 3 and less than 20 years; long: 20 years or more.
protocol.interpretation: Chosen as the most defensible score for the stated same-unit absolute daily-CRPS objective. Positive forecast-independent weights preserve CRPS propriety. This does not make raw CRPS universally superior: fixed positive SD and sqrt-lead rescaling also define proper but different objectives. The relative headline is a presentation against a fixed baseline, not itself a proper scoring rule.

coverage.disclosure: Current values are conditional partial-support development diagnostics, not the completed 320,017-request panel score. Coverage is incomplete and its support is not shown to be representative; do not extrapolate or promote as a full-panel result.

distinct_alternative_estimand.note: This gives each bucket's percentage change equal influence and is not the selected equal-third mean-loss ratio.
